public_executable_paths.note: Exact ratchet, not just a ceiling check: check_script_surface.py requires the live public-role count to equal `count` exactly, so deleting a public script requires lowering this number in the same change instead of leaving silent headroom under `ceiling`. `ceiling` is the plan's closeout limit (docs/plans/scripts-tools-surface-cleanup.md); `count` may sit anywhere at or below it.
